LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 MODAL AUXILIARIES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which words do we use to express requests, permission, ability and obligation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify modal auxiliaries in a passage
2. use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify modal auxiliaries in a passage
   In simple words: practise until you can identify modal auxiliaries in a passage. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods
   In simple words: practise until you can use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries.
4. Show that you can: identify modal auxiliaries in a passage

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Form sentences using the modal auxiliaries
2. Read a dialogue featuring modal auxiliaries in pairs,
3. Listen to a song or read a poem and identify the modal auxiliaries used,
4. View pictures and diagrams and ask questions using modal auxiliaries,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify modal auxiliaries in a passage
2. use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
